name: Natalius Chendana
bio:
Natalius Chendana (born December 24, 1987) is an Indonesian actor.

Natalius is a former Men's Health finalist in 2012. In 2013, she is believed to play the role of a gregarious man in a 3Sum omnibus movie, followed by the following year, finally getting her first chance to play her voice through her role in an independent film titled The Sun, The Moon & The Hurricane.

From ID Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
